Annotation Interface HandlerThread

@Documented @Retention(CLASS) @Target({METHOD,CONSTRUCTOR,TYPE,PARAMETER}) public @interface HandlerThread
Indicates that the launching thread must have an Android Handler to execute due to the GeckoResult.

If called from a thread without the required Handler, the code will throw IllegalThreadStateException with message "Must have a Handler".
